description: This file defines the 'FieldToSession' class, a method operation for the Apache OFBiz MiniLang framework. It implements functionality to transfer a field value into a session attribute within a specific event context.

classes.name: FieldToSession
classes.description: A method operation that moves a specified field value into the session under a given name during an event.

classes.name: FieldToSessionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FieldToSession.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: retrieves a field value and stores it in the session if conditions are met.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Creates a new instance of FieldToSession.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this operation type.
